comparison.objective: Commission a shock absorber versus lock out an air-conditioner pull-out disconnect.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate requires recessed tooling, fine adjustment, and controlled tightening; record opens a cover, extracts and flips a keyed block, reinserts it OFF, closes the cover, and threads/snaps a padlock.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate requires two repeatable safe stops; record requires the correct disconnect in OFF orientation, cover shut, padlock secured, and no interaction with the other disconnect or reinsertion in ON.
comparison.reason: Safety lockout sequencing and keyed reorientation test a different ability from tuning impact response. Candidate dynamic and drift thresholds are partly unspecified.
